# Dropbox

> Dropbox is a comprehensive cloud collaboration platform offering file storage, sharing, AI-powered search, document signing, and specialized tools for creative teams and enterprises.

Dropbox provides integrated solutions for file management, team collaboration, document workflows, and content organization across multiple products including Dash AI, Sign, Replay, and DocSend. The platform serves individual users, small teams, and enterprises across industries including sales, marketing, creative, construction, and manufacturing.

## Key Topics

- Cloud Storage
- File Sharing
- Team Collaboration
- Dash AI
- eSignature
- Document Signing
- Dropbox Sign
- Dropbox Replay
- Workflow Automation
- AI Search
- Security
- File Organization
- Creative Collaboration
- Contract Management
- Integrations

## Core Products

- [Dropbox](https://www.dropbox.com/dropbox): Core Dropbox product overview covering storage, organization, security features.
- [Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com): Dropbox Dash AI-powered universal search and content organization platform.
- [Dropbox Sign](https://www.dropbox.com/sign): Dropbox Sign eSignature product for document signing and workflow automation.
- [Dropbox Replay](https://www.dropbox.com/replay): Dropbox Replay video review and collaboration tool for creative teams.
- [DocSend](https://www.dropbox.com/docsend): DocSend secure file sharing and document analytics platform by Dropbox.
- [Dropbox Fax](https://fax.dropbox.com): Dropbox Fax online faxing service for secure document transmission.

## Features & Capabilities

- [Cloud Storage](https://www.dropbox.com/features/cloud-storage): Dropbox cloud storage features: security, compliance, multi-device sync.
- [Secure File Sharing](https://www.dropbox.com/features/share): Dropbox file sharing features: secure links, access control, collaboration.
- [Send Large Files](https://www.dropbox.com/features/share/send-large-files): Dropbox Transfer feature for securely sending large files up to 250GB.
- [Electronic Signature](https://www.dropbox.com/features/productivity/electronic-signature): Dropbox Sign eSignature feature for secure document signing workflows.

## Industry Solutions

- [Dropbox for Sales Teams](https://www.dropbox.com/business/solutions/sales): Dropbox solution for sales teams: contracts, proposals, deal closing.
- [Dropbox for Marketing Teams](https://www.dropbox.com/business/solutions/marketing): Dropbox solution for marketing teams: creative review and collaboration.
- [Dropbox for Creative Teams](https://www.dropbox.com/business/solutions/creatives): Dropbox for creative teams: video production, asset management, review.
- [Dropbox for HR Teams](https://www.dropbox.com/business/solutions/human-resources): Dropbox solution for HR: onboarding, document signing, compliance.
- [Dropbox for IT Professionals](https://www.dropbox.com/business/solutions/it): Dropbox solution for IT: collaboration, security, workflow automation.
- [Dropbox for Construction](https://www.dropbox.com/business/solutions/construction): Dropbox solution for construction: CAD/BIM management, field collaboration.
- [Dropbox for Manufacturing](https://www.dropbox.com/business/solutions/manufacturing): Dropbox solution for manufacturing: design, engineering, IP protection.
- [Dropbox for Technology Companies](https://www.dropbox.com/business/solutions/technology): Dropbox solution for tech companies: product development, collaboration.
